{{BSE|532834}} | genre = | fate = | predecessor = | successor = | founded = | founder = | defunct = | hq_location_city = [[Mumbai]], [[Maharashtra]] | hq_location_country = India | hq_location = | num_locations = | area_served = [[South Asia]], [[Mexico]] and [[Central America]] | key_people = Ashish Subhash Dandekar (Managing Director){{cite news | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/meet-ashish-dandekar-the-camlin-scion-who-writes-his-own-success-story/articleshow/47824985.cms | title=Meet Ashish Dandekar, the Camlin scion who writes his own success story | newspaper=The Economic Times | last1=M | first1=Sabarinath }}{{cite web|url=https://www.camlinfs.com/boards_committe.php|title=Camlin Fine Sciences - High quality shelf life extension solutions|website=www.camlinfs.com|accessdate=11 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612144008/https://www.camlinfs.com/boards_committe.php|archive-date=12 June 2018|url-status=dead}} | industry = [[Speciality chemicals]] | products = | services = | revenue = | operating_income = | net_income = | aum = | assets = | equity = | owner = | num_employees = | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | website = [https://www.camlinfs.com www.camlinfs.com] | footnotes = | intl = }} '''Camlin Fine Sciences''' originated as part of the Camlin group, an Indian manufacturer of stationery and art materials. The company subsequently expanded into the specialty chemicals sector, focusing on antioxidant ingredients and related chemical products. During the 2000s and 2010s, the company expanded its international operations through acquisitions and investments in overseas manufacturing facilities. These activities increased the company's presence in Europe and Latin America and broadened its product portfolio. In 2015, Camlin Fine Sciences acquired a controlling interest in Dresen Química, a Brazilian manufacturer of food preservation and shelf-life extension products. The acquisition expanded the company's operations in South America. The company later expanded its activities in aroma chemicals and vanillin production through investments in manufacturing facilities and related businesses. Company manufactures [[chemical substance|chemicals]] to improve the [[shelf life]] of food and other products like [[aroma compounds|aromatic compounds]], and [[Performance-enhancing substance|performance chemicals]]. CFS has emerged as the largest producer of food [[antioxidant]]s such as [[tert-Butylhydroquinone]] (TBHQ) and [[Butylated hydroxyanisole]] (BHA). It is also one of the world's leading [[Vanillin]] producers.{{Cite web |url=http://fmtmagazine.in/news/camlin-fine-sciences-becomes-worlds-third-largest-vanillin-producer |title=CAMLIN FINE SCIENCES BECOMES WORld's THIRD LARGEST VANILLIN PRODUCER - Food Marketing & Technology |access-date=21 May 2018 |archive-date=22 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180522112003/http://fmtmagazine.in/news/camlin-fine-sciences-becomes-worlds-third-largest-vanillin-producer/ |url-status=dead }} CFS has offices and manufacturing facilities in several countries, such as [[India]], [[China]], [[Italy]], [[Brazil]], [[Mexico]] and the [[United States]].{{Cite web |url=http://agrofoodpark.com/companies-in-agro-food-park/companies-in-agro-food-park/camlin-fine-sciences |title=Camlin Fine Sciences |access-date=21 May 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180522111333/http://agrofoodpark.com/companies-in-agro-food-park/companies-in-agro-food-park/camlin-fine-sciences |archive-date=22 May 2018 |url-status=dead }} Having established global leadership in antioxidants, CFS expanded their business with forward integrated into antioxidant blends{{Clarify|date=October 2018}} and has widened its application to the food and beverage industry, [[pet food]], [[animal feed]], [[fishmeal]], [[aquaculture]], [[biodiesel]], etc.[http://backoffice.phillipcapital.in/Backoffice/Researchfiles/Researchfilesmove/PC_-_Camlin_Fine_Science_Initiating_-_Mar_2016_20160331190624.pdf Camlin Fine Sciences (CFIN IN)] backoffice.phillipcapital.in Camlin Fine Sciences holds the patent for an improved process in the synthesis of BHA [[Butylated hydroxyanisole]] from TBHQ [[tert-Butylhydroquinone]] {{cite web | url=https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2007015260A3/en | title=Improvement in synthesis of butylated hydroxyanisole from tertiary butyl hydroquinone }} == History == In 1984, Camlin Fine Chemicals Division was started by [[Kokuyo Camlin|Camlin]] with the setting up of a new ultra-modern plant at [[Tarapur, Maharashtra|Tarapur]], India. In 2006, Camlin Fine Chemicals demerged from the parent company, and an entirely new entity was formed called Camlin Fine Sciences Ltd. In 2007, CFS was listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]].{{cite web|url=https://www.camlinfs.com/journey.php|title=Camlin Fine Sciences - High quality shelf life extension solutions|website=www.camlinfs.com|accessdate=11 May 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180511013556/https://www.camlinfs.com/journey.php|archive-date=11 May 2018|url-status=dead}} In 2011, CFS got listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India]]. In 2011, CFS took the firm overseas with the acquisition of Borregaard Italia SpA, a [[hydroquinone]] and [[catechol]] manufacturing facility at [[Ravenna]], Italy through its wholly owned subsidiary in [[Mauritius]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/camlin-fine-chemicals-buys-italyrsquos-borregaard/article23050272.ece|title=Camlin Fine Chemicals buys Italy's Borregaard|date=9 March 2011 |publisher=|accessdate=11 May 2018}} In 2014, CFS began operations in Brazil through its 100% subsidiary company CFS do Brasil Ltd, where it commenced production of antioxidant blends for food applications. In 2016, CFS acquired 65% stake in Dresen Quimica S.A.P.I.de C.V., Mexico, along with its group companies and subsidiaries. In July 2017, CFS became the 3rd largest producer of vanillin in the world with the acquisition of 51% stake in Ningbo Wanglong Flavors & Fragrances Company Ltd., China.{{cite news|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/camlin-fine-sciences-buys-51-stake-in-chinese-firm-117071201360_1.html|title=Camlin Fine Sciences buys 51% stake in Chinese firm|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=12 July 2017|publisher=|accessdate=11 May 2018|via=Business Standard|agency=Press Trust of India }}{{cite web|url=https://www.vccircle.com/camlin-fine-sciences-buys-51-stake-in-chinese-chemical-firm/|title=Camlin Fine Sciences buys 51% stake in Chinese chemical firm|date=12 July 2017|publisher=|accessdate=11 May 2018}}{{cite web|url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-camlin-fine-sciences-buys-51-stake-in-chinese-firm-2500235|title=Camlin Fine Sciences buys 51% stake in Chinese firm - Latest News & Updates at Daily News & Analysis|date=12 July 2017|publisher=|accessdate=11 May 2018}} In November 2017, CFS entered into a preferred supply agreement with Lockheed Martin Advanced Energy Storage for the manufacturing and supply of a specialty chemical.{{cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/announcements/camlin-fine-sciences-updates-2439367.html|title=Camlin Fine Sciences enters into agreement with Lockheed Martin Advanced Energy Storage|website=Moneycontrol|date=15 November 2017 |accessdate=11 May 2018}}{{Cite news|url=https://in.reuters.com/article/brief-camlin-fine-sciences-enters-prefer/brief-camlin-fine-sciences-enters-preferred-supply-agreement-with-lockheed-martin-advanced-energy-storage-idINFWN1NK1NF|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180511012805/https://in.reuters.com/article/brief-camlin-fine-sciences-enters-prefer/brief-camlin-fine-sciences-enters-preferred-supply-agreement-with-lockheed-martin-advanced-energy-storage-idINFWN1NK1NF|url-status=dead|archive-date=11 May 2018|title=BRIEF-Camlin Fine Sciences enters preferred supply agreement with Lockheed Martin Advanced Energy Storage |newspaper=Reuters |date=15 November 2017 }} In April 2018, CFS entered into an Animal Nutrition joint venture with Pahang Pharma (S) Pte. Ltd., Singapore. In 2018, Camlin Fine Sciences entered into a joint venture with Pahang Pharma (S) Pte. Ltd., Singapore, through the formation of CFS Pahang, to expand its presence in the animal nutrition sector.https://www.camlinfs.com/cfsna/AboutCFS In 2020 The company completed a greenfield expansion project at Dahej Special Economic Zone in Gujarat and commenced commercial production at its diphenol manufacturing facility.https://www.camlinfs.com/about-us/ The expansion increased the company's manufacturing capacity for hydroquinone- and catechol-based chemical products used in industrial and specialty chemical applications.https://www.camlinfs.com/performance-chemicals/ == Business verticals == ===Shelf life solutions === Having established global leadership in antioxidants, CFS moved forward in blending by setting up a unit in Tarapur, India and in Brazil in 2014. Today, CFS has its blending facilities across the world (India, China, Mexico, USA and Brazil). It has a portfolio of more than 100 natural shelf-life extending products under the brand names Xtendra and NaSure. The company has widened its applications for different food industries such as snacks, bakery, meat & poultry, spices & seasonings, etc., and has also tapped potential shelf life solutions{{Clarify|date=October 2018}} in fried snacks, pet food, fishmeal, biodiesel, confectionery, animal feed.{{Cite web|url=https://indiainfoline.com/company/undefined-share-price/management-discussions/27793|title=Check out the undefined-share-price Management Discussions | Live stock/Share Prices at indiainfoline.com|website=indiainfoline.com|accessdate=29 September 2023}} CFS acquired a 65% stake in Dresen Quimica S.A.P.I. de C.V., Mexico, to cover Central America and Andean States. Dresen is in the Mexican food and feed blends business. With this acquisition, the portfolio expanded to geographies in Mexico and Central America with products like antioxidant blends (traditional and natural), feed additives, etc.{{cite web | url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/xbaLjsEwmEmZeXoK1kpj2K/Camlin-Fine-Sciences-Mexican-unit-acquires-65-stake-in-Dre.html | title=Camlin Fine Sciences' Mexican unit acquires 65% stake in Dresen Quimica | date=5 May 2016 }} ===Aroma ingredients=== CFS produces vanillin and ethyl vanillin using fully traceable, vertically integrated production.{{Cite web |url=https://www.ingredientsnetwork.com/camlin-fine-sciences-comp248751.html |title=Camlin Fine Sciences |access-date=11 June 2018 |archive-date=12 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180612135853/https://www.ingredientsnetwork.com/camlin-fine-sciences-comp248751.html |url-status=dead }} CFS uses an environmentally friendly method for producing vanillin and ethyl vanillin (sold under the brand names Vanesse and Evanil, respectively) from Catechol. The company makes all key ingredients in-house and has gained acceptance as a quality global vanillin player. The brands Vanesse (vanillin) and Evanil (ethyl vanillin) have grown their customer base not only from the food and flavor industry, but also manufacturers of fragrances, incense sticks, and pharmaceuticals industries and perfumeries.{{cite web | url=http://www.foodingredientsfirst.com/news/camlin-fine-sciences-becomes-worlds-third-largest-vanillin-producer.html | title=Camlin Fine Sciences Becomes World's Third-Largest Vanillin Producer }} The company has also launched floral booster, which is specially developed for the incense stick industry to enhance sweet note, sustain burning, and aroma-spreading properties along with Intense Green-a fragrance and flavour chemical, and Vetigreen-an aromatic chemical for home cleaning solutions, personal care products, cosmetics, and incense sticks.{{Cite web |url=http://corporateethos.com/corporate-domain/camlin-fine-sciences-acquires-51-in-china-firm-stock-hits-new-one-month-high |title=Camlin Fine Sciences Acquires 51% in China Firm; Stock Hits New One-Month High | CORPORATE ETHOS |access-date=21 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180621194014/http://corporateethos.com/corporate-domain/camlin-fine-sciences-acquires-51-in-china-firm-stock-hits-new-one-month-high |archive-date=21 June 2018 |url-status=dead }} ===Performance chemicals=== The company entered intothe performance chemicals segment with the acquisition of Borregaard Italia Spa Ltd in March 2011 and became one of the largest producers of di-phenols (Hydroquinone and Catechol). To cater the demand from the market CFS has doubled its guaiacol capacity to 4000 [[tonne]]s per annum and raised veratrole capacity by 67% to 1000 tonnes per annum in FY16 and this will lead to 17% sales CAGR over FY15-18 to Rs 2.04bn.{{update inline|date=January 2020}} CFS has distribution hubs in different parts of the world to cater to customer demands. == References == {{Reflist}} {{Authority control}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Camlin}} [[Category:Manufacturing companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Chemical companies established in 1931]] [[Category:Indian brands]] [[Category:Chemical companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]]

The company subsequently expanded into the specialty chemicals sector, focusing on antioxidant ingredients and related chemical products. During the 2000s and 2010s, the company expanded its international operations through acquisitions and investments in overseas manufacturing facilities. 
These activities increased the company's presence in Europe and Latin America and broadened its product portfolio. In 2015, Camlin Fine Sciences acquired a controlling interest in Dresen Química, a Brazilian manufacturer of food preservation and shelf-life extension products. The acquisition expanded the company's operations in South America. The company later expanded its activities in aroma chemicals and vanillin production through investments in manufacturing facilities and related businesses.
Company manufactures chemicals to improve the shelf life of food and other products like aromatic compounds, and performance chemicals. CFS has emerged as the largest producer of food antioxidants such as tert-Butylhydroquinone (TBHQ) and Butylated hydroxyanisole (BHA). It is also one of the world's leading Vanillin producers.
CFS has offices and manufacturing facilities in several countries, such as India, China, Italy, Brazil, Mexico and the United States. Having established global leadership in antioxidants, CFS expanded their business with forward integrated into antioxidant blends and has widened its application to the food and beverage industry, pet food, animal feed, fishmeal, aquaculture, biodiesel, etc.
